meta.author: rukkiecodes
meta.note: Token values come from references/tokens.md and references/colors.md (the repo's production set). references/apple-design-source.md supplied only the hero-image shadow value and the 1.47 body leading. No component code, font files or brand assets exist in the repository; components are hand-written from references/components.md. The Readable theme is not from the source: it is an added accessible theme, and Light holds the repo's exact values.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Action Blue — the only interactive colour: links, primary CTA fills, active tab, selected chip, focus root, progress fills. 5.6:1 as text or a mark on canvas, canvasParchment and surfacePearl. Never a second accent.

tokens.name: primaryFocus
tokens.usage: A hair brighter than primary: the 2px border on a selected card or chosen option, and the keyboard focus ring. 4.7:1 on canvas. The only place 2px appears.

tokens.name: primaryOnDark
tokens.usage: Interactive text and links on dark surfaces (surfaceTile1–3, surfaceBlack) and over photography, where primary disappears. 4.9:1 on surfaceTile1.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Near-black, not pure black: every headline and body string on light surfaces. 16.5:1 on canvas, 14.8:1 on canvasParchment and surfacePearl.

tokens.name: body
tokens.usage: The body-copy name for the same near-black as ink, so copy and headlines share one tone on canvas, canvasParchment and surfacePearl.

tokens.name: bodyOnDark
tokens.usage: All text on dark tiles and the nav bar: 14.9:1 on surfaceTile1, 21:1 on surfaceBlack.

tokens.name: bodyMuted
tokens.usage: Secondary copy on dark surfaces, where pure white reads too loud: 9.3:1 on surfaceTile1.

tokens.name: inkMuted80
tokens.usage: Softer body — supporting copy and chip labels on light surfaces: 12.6:1 on canvas, 11.3:1 on canvasParchment.

tokens.name: inkMuted48
tokens.usage: Captions, placeholders, disabled text, muted icons and fine print on canvas, canvasParchment and surfacePearl. Light keeps the source's value: 4.3:1 on canvas and 3.9:1 on canvasParchment, under 4.5:1 for small text. Readable darkens it to 5.0:1, 4.6:1 and 4.8:1.

tokens.name: dividerSoft
tokens.usage: The softest 1px separator — between grouped rows and on secondary buttons. Reads as a ring, not a line.

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: The default 1px border and separator: card edges, input borders, list dividers, gauge tracks.

tokens.name: canvas
tokens.usage: The dominant background: most screens, cards, inputs, sheets, dialogs.

tokens.name: canvasParchment
tokens.usage: The signature off-white: alternating sections, filled fields, chips, gauge tiles and pressed rows.

tokens.name: surfacePearl
tokens.usage: Near-white fill for grouped rows and ghost buttons; reads as a surface against canvasParchment.

tokens.name: surfaceTile1
tokens.usage: The primary dark tile and the info toast ground; carries bodyOnDark, bodyMuted and primaryOnDark.

tokens.name: surfaceTile2
tokens.usage: A micro-step lighter dark tile, for a tile sitting next to surfaceTile1.

tokens.name: surfaceTile3
tokens.usage: A micro-step darker dark tile: the bottom of a dark stack, and video frames.

tokens.name: surfaceBlack
tokens.usage: True void only: the nav bar, video, and full-bleed photographic overlays.

tokens.name: chipTranslucent
tokens.usage: Base hex of the translucent grey control chip over photography, applied at about 64% alpha.

tokens.name: onPrimary
tokens.usage: Label and icon on a filled primary surface (5.6:1) or a filled danger surface (3.6:1 in Light — the source's pairing, kept exact; 5.0:1 in Readable).

tokens.name: onDark
tokens.usage: Text and icons on any dark surface: 14.9:1 on surfaceTile1, 21:1 on surfaceBlack.

tokens.name: onDark60
tokens.usage: Translucent white for controls resting over photography. Decorative over imagery only — never body copy.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: The dim behind modals, alerts and action sheets. This is the system's depth, in place of a shadow.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Destructive actions, errors, the error input border and the error toast ground. Light is the source's value: 3.6:1 on canvas, enough for a border or 24px+ text but under 4.5:1 for small text. Readable is 5.0:1 on canvas and 4.6:1 on canvasParchment, and carries white at 5.0:1.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Positive money and earnings figures, and success gauge fills. Light is the source's value at 2.2:1 on canvas; Readable is 5.0:1 on canvas and 4.6:1 on canvasParchment. In both themes success and danger are told apart by hue, not lightness, so always carry the label word too.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Caution states — 'under review', 'awaiting payment' — as a badge foreground on canvasParchment. Light is the source's value at 2.0:1 there; Readable is 4.6:1. Always with its label word.

families.sans: system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "SF Pro Text", "Helvetica Neue", sans-serif

styles.name: heroDisplay
styles.usage: The largest display read on the ramp; the source names no screen that spends it.

styles.name: title1
styles.usage: Display headline above title2; the source names no screen that spends it.

styles.name: title2
styles.usage: The large collapsing screen title, and the headline on every plain screen.

styles.name: title3
styles.usage: Empty-state titles and the fixed dashboard greeting.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Default paragraph and every button label. 17px is the brand's reading pace, and body leading never tightens below 1.47.

styles.name: callout
styles.usage: Supporting copy inside cards, sheets and dialogs.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Secondary captions, helper and error lines, sheet headers, chip and badge labels.

styles.name: micro
styles.usage: Timestamps, legal lines, and the unread count on a notification badge.

styles.name: headline-semiBold
styles.usage: Card titles, dialog titles and the StatGauge value.

styles.name: body-semiBold
styles.usage: The collapsed inline header title, and cancel actions in a dialog.

spacing.note: An 8pt-ish base with two sub-steps for tight typographic adjustments. Structural layout snaps to spacing-sm, spacing-base, spacing-lg and spacing-xl.

tokens.name: spacing-xxs
tokens.usage: Chip and badge vertical padding — the tightest nudge on the scale.

tokens.name: spacing-xs
tokens.usage: Gap between a label and its control, and between chips in a row.

tokens.name: spacing-sm
tokens.usage: Gap inside a row of controls, OTP box gap, toast offset below the safe area.

tokens.name: spacing-md
tokens.usage: Button and text-input vertical padding.

tokens.name: spacing-base
tokens.usage: Compact tile, gauge and field padding; the smaller gap between stacked rows.

tokens.name: spacing-lg
tokens.usage: Card and dialog interior padding, and the gap between stacked form fields or list rows.

tokens.name: spacing-xl
tokens.usage: The screen gutter, button horizontal padding, and the step between major sections.

tokens.name: spacing-xxl
tokens.usage: The wider step between major sections.

tokens.name: spacing-xxxl
tokens.usage: Sits between spacing-xxl and spacing-huge on the scale; the source states no specific use.

tokens.name: spacing-huge
tokens.usage: Empty-state vertical padding.

radius.note: Pair every radius with continuous (squircle) corners, and never invent an in-between value.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inline and compact surfaces.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Small tiles, text-input field boxes and OTP boxes.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, dialogs, action sheets, toasts and grouped rows.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Large hero surfaces and onboarding imagery.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Anything that reads as an action: primary CTAs, search inputs, filter chips, status badges, pager dots.

shadow.note: There is no shadow system. UI depth is a surface-colour change, a 1px hairline, or the scrim behind a modal.

tokens.name: shadow-hero
tokens.usage: The only shadow in the language: hero or product imagery resting on a surface. Never on a card, button, sheet, input, chip or text.
